acknowledgePeek.title: Policy peek
acknowledgePeek.hint: The next three policies, top of the pile first. Only you can see them.

specialElection.hint: Choose the next President. Afterwards, the order resumes from your left.

execute.title: Execution
execute.hint: The executed player leaves the game. If it is Hitler, the Liberals win.
